scope: Read-only book spacing, typography, image presentation and rendering audit. No source changes, regeneration, browser use or fresh historical/image-rights certification.

limitations: All 530 pages were visually triaged at contact-sheet scale; only the listed 25 distinct pages received full-size inspection across this and the immediately preceding same-artifact review.
The first oversized print contact output failed and was not counted; all 24 print contact sheets were subsequently viewed successfully in batches of four.
No physical print, assistive-technology or full Odia linguistic proofreading performed. No every-page full-size PASS is claimed.

findings.finding: A six-line paragraph occupies page 188 by itself immediately before the forced drawing and final section on page 189.
findings.impact: The closing argument is interrupted by a largely empty leaf before its final invitation; this is more disruptive than the intentional portrait frontispieces.
findings.evidence_excerpt: A children’s or family screening could let younger viewers encounter Odia as a language of imagination.
findings.recommendation: Try a local reflow before the closing section, preserving body font, prose and meaningful drawing. Avoid shrinking the whole chapter or adding filler artwork to page 188.
findings.print_comparison: Print 189–190 has a coherent three-paragraph final leaf (about twelve lines), not an equivalent six-line intervening fragment; its open closing space is a defensible design choice.

findings.finding: Contents pages inherit the running header “Follow the central question” from the preceding route page.
findings.impact: A small but real navigation-label mismatch when browsing a long book.
findings.recommendation: Give the Contents run its own “Contents” header, or omit the running header there.
findings.verification: Page 4 viewed full size in both editions; remaining Contents pages viewed on contact sheets.

findings.finding: The approved large Nirad portrait leaves two lines of the introductory paragraph on page 88; the sentence continues on page 89.
findings.impact: Image emphasis competes with opening-paragraph continuity. No crop, caption clipping or attribution loss was observed.
findings.recommendation: Treat as an optional tradeoff, not a blocker: preserve the user-approved 85% portrait unless they prefer moving the entire first paragraph to the next page. Do not reduce or recrop automatically.

findings.finding: Some chapters end with a separate, mostly empty Watch-and-explore leaf. Digital 171/print 172 carry two provider links and the short transition; print 108 is Nandita’s viewing list.
findings.impact: Occasional additional page turns after the narrative has ended. The access qualifications and links are useful and should remain.
findings.recommendation: Optional targeted grouping/spacing review only if a preceding page can accommodate the complete viewing section; do not force every chapter to fill its final page or add unrelated line art.
findings.verification: Digital 171 full size; print examples contact-level triage.

findings.finding: The printed URL directory contains very long encoded addresses and occasional source labels separated from the URL onto the next line (e.g. S58, S371).
findings.impact: Intact and readable at zoom, but awkward to transcribe from paper; the source directory is a reference apparatus rather than comfortable narrative reading.
findings.recommendation: Keep exact source destinations and required credits. For a future print refinement, consider a stable human-readable online source index alongside this directory, and keep a source label with at least the beginning of its URL. Do not use unverified or ephemeral URL shortening.

positive_observations: Body typography is consistent: sampled prose uses 11pt text, sampled section heads 14pt, captions/directory 9pt. No obvious clipping or off-page image at contact-sheet scale.
Current compact digital author portrait shares page 8 with heading and opening; the print edition deliberately retains a complete portrait frontispiece on page 8 followed by the text on page 9.
Prafulla digital52/print53 and Nandita digital106/print105 preserve complete contextual photographs on separate leaves; these are intentional presentation choices, not accidental empty pages.

Parbati print67 stamp and print69 facsimile retain their complete artifact boundaries and numbered credits. The narrow stamp caption wraps but its number remains attached; the facsimile is an illustrative document image, not a promise of comfortable full-text reading at book size.
Sampled closing line art remains subordinate to text and visibly distinct from documentary photographs. Maya/Bhukha/Pratikshya tail drawings appear cohesive at contact scale.
The print closing on189–190 is airy but coherent; no need to keep chasing its white space.
Repaired Manglu/music and Bijay/Sabyasachi endings remain coherent in same-hash full-size evidence from the prior phase.
Odia glyphs are visibly present in the sampled Parbati titles and final saying; no tofu boxes or visible missing-glyph blocks found. This is not comprehensive linguistic proofreading.

accessibility_limits.assessment: Real PDF tagging/reading-order and language-run accessibility remains a separate previously acknowledged task. No PDF/UA, screen-reader or AT conformance claim. Existing internal link checks from the preceding same-hash review remain applicable, but no new interaction audit performed here.

decision: No critical missing-content, clipped-page or demonstrated false-image-identity defect found within this visual scope. Recommend fixing the digital closing fragment and Contents header; other points are optional design/reference usability improvements. Image-to-story factual fit is separately owned by Anvesha.
